lines.text: The people must destroy the nations' worship places, tear down their altars, smash their pillars, and burn their Asherah poles.
The people must go to the place the LORD chooses from their tribes, and there they eat and rejoice.
After they cross the Euphrates, the LORD will give them rest from all the enemies around them.
The people may slaughter and eat meat within any of their gates, but they must not eat the blood.
The people must eat their tithes at the LORD's chosen place, with their sons, daughters, and the Benjamite.
